verdict: Same calories, an estimated ~250 kcal. Apam balik with peanuts wins slightly because it has more protein and less fat.
why: 1 sugar donut and 1 large piece of apam balik are both an estimated ~250 kcal.
Apam balik has 6 g protein (thanks to the peanuts), the donut 4 g.
Apam balik fat is 10 g, the donut 12 g. Donuts are deep-fried, apam balik is cooked on a flat pan.
Careful, apam balik is usually sold as a whole piece. If you eat the whole thing, the calories can be several times higher.
when_a: A sugar donut is okay as an occasional sweet treat, for example at a kenduri or a weekend breakfast.
when_b: Apam balik suits you when you buy it at the pasar malam and share it with the family, not eat it alone.
tip: When you buy apam balik at the pasar malam, cut it right away and share it with the family. Take one piece for yourself and enjoy it slowly.

faq.q: Is apam balik without peanuts lower in calories?
faq.a: Maybe slightly, but you also lose the protein from the peanuts. It's better to control the size of your piece than to remove the peanuts.

faq.q: Is a donut okay for breakfast?
faq.a: Once in a while, yes. It's just low in protein, so you might get hungry early. Pair it with a boiled egg so you stay fuller.
